anya: Heads-up: I mapped out a proposed Q2 split for enterprise compliance work. Need a decision on what we put in sprint-12 vs later. Short list: evidence export MVP (tenant-scoped immutable bundle), BYOK handshake + rotation spike, per-tenant retention controls and residency toggles.

mike: Sounds good. For the BYOK spike I'll need 2w to prove handshake + rotation semantics, plus 3 days to run through HSM edge cases. Blocker: service account to talk to customer KMS (eng-infra).

sofia: Security constraints: exported bundles must include an append-only manifest (sha256 list), signer info, and tamper-evident chain. Add legal-hold flag so deletes are blocked even past TTL. Rotation must be replay-safe: old keys still validate historic bundles.

nate: Sales feedback: HealthCo & FinBank pushing for exports + residency. HealthCo requires per-region evidence for audit; FinBank wants 7yr retention and tenant-level retention override. Both will pay for early access.

anya: Proposed acceptance criteria for export MVP:
- Endpoint that returns an immutable snapshot for tenant/date range in NDJSON, with manifest and signature.
- Export access audit included in bundle (who exported + reason).
- Delta export mode for incremental snapshots.
- SLA: complete <30m for <=100GB.

mike: I'll schedule the BYOK spike first. Will draft an implementation plan: handshake API, rotation waveform, compatibility tests. Call out infra creds asap.

sofia: I'll produce a short security checklist for the export and rotation workflows (signed manifests, export access audit, legal-hold semantics). Due Wed.

nate: I'll consolidate customer asks + proposed pricing for pilot. Due Wed.

eng-infra-bot: Credential request submitted: ticket #INF-721. ETA 48h.

anya: Quick poll: move export MVP (MUST) into sprint-12?
mike: :thumbsup: move it.

sofia: :thumbsup: pending checklist.

nate: :thumbsup: pilot interest confirmed.

anya: Great. I'll lock sprint-12 for the export MVP and kick the BYOK spike immediately. Will post updated scope doc in #product and link security checklist when Sofia completes. Thanks.
